name: Builder
description: Put a blueprint in a schematic table, choose a saved schematic and anchor its ghost. Stock the chests touching the table with every block the design needs, then press Start: a Mason Golem digs itself out of the ground, fetches blocks and tools, clears what is in the way and builds the design, then burrows back down.
summary: Schematic table, blueprints and the Mason Golem.
